testcase.system-out: Scenario: Reset Recent column settings after hiding Location ✔ Given the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native` ✔ And the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And recent documents are displayed in List View ✔ And Location is displayed immediately after Name ✔ When the user opens Column Settings and clears Location ✔ Then the Location column disappears ✔ When the user chooses Reset to default ✔ Then Location is checked in Available Columns ✔ And Location is displayed immediately after Name again ✔ And Column Settings remains open
